sources.title: LFM3-1.7B - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: 1.7B text model for local agents and specialized applications, with a 256K context window and native tool calling ← Back to Text Models LFM3-1.7B is Liquid AI’s text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on the new LFM3 tri-hybrid architecture.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Works with vLLM, SGLang, and LFM3-compatible llama.cpp builds. For llama.cpp, use a GGUF with the current chat template or load it with --chat-template-file. See Deferred tools and tool search for the full guide. Fine-tuning LFM3-1.7B is designed for easy customization for a given domain, task, or application via TRL.
